## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 85 captures during November 2023. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the reporting month. The volume should be reviewed alongside image quality and grading outcomes to support routine service monitoring.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 9 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 10.6 per cent. This result should be monitored through the usual quality assurance arrangements. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that any equipment-related concerns can be identified and followed up through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

There were 12 referable results during November 2023. The median grading wait was 2 days. These results provide a summary of the grading workload and the time taken for cases to progress through grading. The site should continue to review grading activity and image quality together, particularly where ungradable captures or recurring camera issues may affect the timely assessment of results.
